calculation: CO-only counterpart of an existing repeatedly missed relaxed CO+H configuration
hold_fixed: Same clean parent, cell, Cu/Au ordering, electronic/broadening settings, top-two absorber populations and CO count/contact motif as CO_H/CO_H_0p083_2CO_1H
vary: Remove only isolated H from the XAS-used CO+H snapshot for an initial vertical diagnostic; then separately relax the CO-only counterpart under the same slab constraints. Label vertical and relaxed comparisons separately.
decision_changing_result: If adding H gives a reproducible signed contribution above matched CO-only site variation and independently estimated measurement/registration uncertainty, pursue residual/contrast features; if not, collect complementary H-sensitive observables rather than lower the cutoff.
reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation

calculation: Replicate CO-only/CO+H matched families in both interface and Cu-rich environments
hold_fixed: Within each family: parent, CO count, CO sites/contact compositions, coverage denominator, reference and numerical settings
vary: H occupancy/location at fixed CO; then change clean parent independently. At least one interface and one Cu-rich family, with independent-parent replication.
decision_changing_result: If H contrast generalizes across parents/environment and survives CO-only motif variation, add matched families to training; if environment-specific, acquire environment-stratified controls before claiming general H inference.
reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation

calculation: Pure CHO and matched CHO/COH connectivity controls
hold_fixed: Same parent, coverage, comparable C/O contact sites, top-two physical populations, reference, spectral settings
vary: C-bound H (CHO) versus O-bound H (COH); include isolated CHO and coadsorbed CHO+CO+H. Verify final C-H/O-H connectivity in the exact XAS geometry.
decision_changing_result: Stable distinct pure-CHO versus COH signatures plus improved held-out pure-CHO recovery justify extending the claim; isomerization/dissociation requires relabeling actual products and narrower claims.
reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation

calculation: COOH/OCHO matched controls if directional errors persist
hold_fixed: Same substrate parent, coverage, binding/contact composition and common intensity scale
vary: O-bound versus C-bound H at fixed CO2H stoichiometry; comparable motif/coverage sweep
decision_changing_result: Persistent directional confusion despite adequate training support motivates matched pairs; otherwise prioritize H and pure CHO first.
reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation

calculation: Additional independent COCHO positives if COCHO remains central
hold_fixed: Verified C-C/C-O/C-H graph; matched clean reference and converged complete top-two spectra
vary: Independent geometries/parents, coverage and motif; acquire several positive groups so each training fold contains positives
decision_changing_result: If independent positive groups allow nonzero held-out recall, assess COCHO inference prospectively; a sole positive group cannot support a general learned-recognition claim.
reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation
